description: From within the dune field, the rippled crests of Maspalomas roll inland under the moon — pale sand ridges catching silver light, with the dark mass of the palm oasis ahead and the sea glimmering beyond. The dunes' curves throw soft shadows in the moonlight, and the whole field seems to breathe in the night wind. By day this is Gran Canaria's great desert by the sea; by night it's a silver wilderness.
